environment.description: Plugin process is spawned inside a pivot_root(2) jail created by the CI runner's executor subsystem. The jail root is a tmpfs mount at /run/executor/<job-id>/ with bind-mounts for only /usr/bin/python3, required .so libraries (enumerated via ldd), and the job workspace. The /var/log/pipeline path inside the jail resolves to /run/executor/<job-id>/var/log/pipeline which is a tmpfs-backed directory with a 10MB size limit. The jail has no bind-mount to the host's actual log directory, no /proc, no /sys, and the mount namespace prevents escape. The Splunk forwarder monitors only /var/log/pipeline on the HOST filesystem which is a completely different mount point unreachable from within the jail. After job completion, the entire /run/executor/<job-id>/ tmpfs is unmounted and discarded. The executor also sets PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS via prctl(2) before exec'ing the plugin.

config.runtime: Custom executor on Ubuntu 22.04 with kernel 6.1
